mapper.select: select id, activity_id, leader_member_id, current_chapter_id, broadcast_text, broadcast_at, status, create_time from club_lead_state where activity_id = #{activityId}
select id, activity_id, leader_member_id, current_chapter_id, broadcast_text, broadcast_at, status, create_time from club_lead_state where activity_id = #{activityId} for update
select member_id from club where id = #{clubId} and del_flag = 0 for update
mapper.update: update club_lead_state set current_chapter_id = #{targetChapterId}, leader_member_id = #{leaderId} where activity_id = #{activityId} and leader_member_id = #{storedLeaderId} and status = 2 and current_chapter_id <=> #{expectedChapterId} and #{leaderId} = coalesce( (select r.target_member_id from club_role_assignment r join cms_activity a on a.club_id = r.club_id where a.id = #{activityId} and r.scope_type = 'EVENT' and r.scope_id = a.id and r.role_code = 'EVENT_LEAD' and r.status = 'ACTIVE' and (r.expires_at is null or r.expires_at > current_timestamp(3)) order by r.id asc limit 1), (select coalesce(c.member_id, a.member_id) from cms_activity a join club c on c.id = a.club_id where a.id = #{activityId}))
mapper.insert: insert into club_lead_state (activity_id, leader_member_id, current_chapter_id, status, create_time) values (#{activityId}, #{leaderMemberId}, #{currentChapterId}, #{status}, #{createTime})
insert into club_lead_checkin (activity_id, member_id, arrived_at) values (#{activityId}, #{memberId}, #{arrivedAt})
mapper.select: select cls.id, cls.activity_id, cls.leader_member_id, cls.current_chapter_id, cls.broadcast_text, cls.broadcast_at, cls.status, cls.create_time from club_lead_state cls inner join cms_activity ca on ca.id = cls.activity_id where ca.topic_id = #{topicId} order by cls.create_time desc

select r.id as registrationId, r.member_id as memberId, m.nickname as nickname, r.payment_status as paymentStatus, r.registration_status as registrationStatus, r.verification_status as verificationStatus, r.verification_time as verificationTime, r.order_num as orderNum, r.create_time as createTime, ck.arrived_at as arrivedAt from cms_registration r left join ums_member m on m.id = r.member_id left join club_lead_checkin ck on ck.activity_id = r.owner_id and ck.member_id = r.member_id where r.owner_type = 2 and r.owner_id = #{activityId} order by r.create_time asc

select o.chapter_id as chapterId, c.name as chapterName, c.sort_id as chapterSort, o.terms_mode as termsMode, o.merchant_id as merchantId, m.nickname as merchantName from merchant_chapter_offer o left join cms_topic_chapter c on c.id = o.chapter_id left join ums_member m on m.id = o.merchant_id where o.topic_id = #{topicId} and o.status = 1 and (o.valid_end is null or o.valid_end > now()) order by c.sort_id asc, o.chapter_id asc

select ca.id as activityId, ca.club_id as clubId, ca.name as activityName, ca.start_date as assemblyTime, coalesce(nullif(ca.address_name, ''), ca.address) as assemblyLocation, coalesce(nullif(leader.nickname, ''), nullif(leader.name, ''), concat('成员#', coalesce(cls.leader_member_id, club.member_id))) as leaderDisplayName, cls.current_chapter_id as currentChapterId, cls.status as status, cls.broadcast_text as broadcastText, cls.broadcast_at as broadcastAt from cms_activity ca inner join club on club.id = ca.club_id and club.del_flag = 0 left join club_lead_state cls on cls.activity_id = ca.id left join ums_member leader on leader.id = coalesce(cls.leader_member_id, club.member_id) and leader.del_flag = 0 where ca.topic_id = #{topicId} and ca.del_flag = 0 and exists ( select 1 from coop_order co where co.topic_id = ca.topic_id and co.to_type = 'club' and co.to_id = ca.club_id and co.status = 0 and co.del_flag = 0 ) order by ca.start_date asc, ca.id asc

select checkin.activity_id as activityId from club_lead_checkin checkin inner join club_lead_state cls on cls.activity_id = checkin.activity_id inner join cms_activity ca on ca.id = checkin.activity_id inner join club on club.id = ca.club_id and club.del_flag = 0 where ca.topic_id = #{topicId} and ca.del_flag = 0 and exists ( select 1 from coop_order co where co.topic_id = ca.topic_id and co.to_type = 'club' and co.to_id = ca.club_id and co.status = 0 and co.del_flag = 0 ) order by checkin.activity_id asc

select ca.id as activityId, ca.topic_id as topicId, topic.name as topicName, ca.name as activityName, ca.start_date as assemblyTime, coalesce(nullif(ca.address_name, ''), ca.address) as assemblyLocation, cls.leader_member_id as leaderMemberId, coalesce(nullif(leader.nickname, ''), nullif(leader.name, ''), concat('成员#', cls.leader_member_id)) as leaderDisplayName, cls.current_chapter_id as currentChapterId, cls.status as status from cms_activity ca inner join club on club.id = ca.club_id and club.del_flag = 0 inner join cms_topic topic on topic.id = ca.topic_id and topic.del_flag = 0 left join club_lead_state cls on cls.activity_id = ca.id left join ums_member leader on leader.id = cls.leader_member_id and leader.del_flag = 0 where ca.club_id = #{clubId} and ca.del_flag = 0 and exists ( select 1 from coop_order co where co.topic_id = ca.topic_id and co.to_type = 'club' and co.to_id = ca.club_id and co.status = 0 and co.del_flag = 0 ) order by ca.start_date asc, ca.id asc

select checkin.activity_id as activityId, checkin.member_id as memberId, coalesce(nullif(member.nickname, ''), nullif(member.name, ''), concat('成员#', checkin.member_id)) as memberDisplayName, checkin.arrived_at as arrivedAt from club_lead_checkin checkin inner join cms_activity ca on ca.id = checkin.activity_id and ca.del_flag = 0 inner join club on club.id = ca.club_id and club.del_flag = 0 left join ums_member member on member.id = checkin.member_id and member.del_flag = 0 where ca.club_id = #{clubId} and exists ( select 1 from coop_order co where co.topic_id = ca.topic_id and co.to_type = 'club' and co.to_id = ca.club_id and co.status = 0 and co.del_flag = 0 ) order by checkin.activity_id asc, checkin.arrived_at asc
